justification: A shows flat, silhouette-style rock carvings of boats with crew strokes, a horned quadruped and small stick figures holding spears, scattered across an open surface; B is a single three-dimensional squatting creature with a large head, incised hatching and limbs drawn up, surmounted by another blocky form. The only overlap is the generic presence of animate figures, with no shared posture, attribute, grouping or drawing convention.
